memory_update.text: CAMT should remain high in the underfollowed lane for HBM/advanced-packaging inspection because it has disclosed recent HBM and tier-1 OSAT AI-related orders; next layer should verify durability of orders, customer concentration, and margin impact.

FORM is a plausible HBM test chokepoint candidate through probe cards and known-good-die test; prioritize verification of HBM-specific revenue mix and whether HBM4/HBM5 creates incremental probe-card upgrade cycles.
KLIC is a narrower bonding-equipment hypothesis: strong fit to heterogeneous integration and TCB, but direct HBM process exposure needs more evidence before promotion beyond Layer 1.

Amkor, Onto Innovation, ASE, substrate suppliers, thermal-material vendors, precision chemical suppliers, and HBM producers remain important adjacent names, but were excluded due to the four-candidate cap and should be revisited in later passes.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM and advanced-packaging upstream-input node using a two-lane funnel. TSM is included as the obvious reference anchor because CoWoS/3DFabric capacity is structurally tied to AI accelerator packaging and HBM integration. The discovery lane emphasizes narrower inspection, metrology, probe-card, and bonding-equipment suppliers where qualification cycles, tool-of-record status, throughput limits, and customer concentration may create chokepoints beneath the already well-known HBM producers.
